history.summary: A 2016 99LH 3BR in coveted D13 Bartley, 260m to Bartley MRT (Circle Line), listed at $1,709 psf — ~16% under the $2,024 district median — on a very thick 250-transaction, 6.2%/yr resale base. Strong location and liquidity, but the development carries documented finish/defect complaints and an unresponsive defects-management reputation.
history.rating_rationale: D13/Bartley is a structurally strong RCR-adjacent node: 260m to Bartley CCL station, central connectivity, reputable schools nearby. The 250-txn URA base gives high-confidence 6.2%/yr appreciation, and $1,709 psf is a real ~16% discount to the $2,024 median on a modern 2016 unit. At $2.3M for 1,346 sqft it sits at the upper edge of the deep buyer band. The cap to Buy (not Strong Buy) is the well-documented build-quality history — visible wall defects, marble scratches, noisy WCs, poor appliance/defect-handling — which is a real resale and own-experience risk to verify unit-by-unit; choose a well-maintained stack.
red_flags: Documented build-quality/defect complaints (wall stains, scratched marble, faulty appliances) and poor defect-management responsiveness

history.summary: Verified-cheap 1BR ($1,652 psf vs ~$1,976 psf 12mo avg) beside Bartley MRT in RCR — genuine value with a real connectivity catalyst, tempered by mixed build quality.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $925K / $1,652 psf for a 560 sqft 1BR sits at the bottom of the project range ($1,652-$2,497) and well below the 12mo avg of ~$1,976 psf (six-month avg ~$1,868), so the -14.7% age-adj and -9.2% vs same-size cohort (22 cohort txns, 250 appreciation txns — solid depth) are corroborated by real transactions, not a quirk. Catalyst is concrete: walkable to Bartley MRT (Circle Line), one of the better-connected nodes; D13 is RCR (~+3.5% realized forward in the v3.4 priors, favorable). Tempered to medium confidence and Buy (not Strong Buy) by mixed build-quality reviews (resident reports of wall defects, stained WCs, scratched flooring) and the usual shoebox exit-liquidity dependence on investor demand.
red_flags: Mixed build-quality reviews — resident defect complaints (walls, WCs, flooring)
Shoebox 1BR exit depends on investor/tenant pool
catalysts: Walkable to Bartley MRT (Circle Line) — strong connectivity
Cheapest 1BR band in project; ~16% below 12mo avg PSF
